FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Precision Countertop Solutions, our operations center around the installation of high-quality countertops and surfaces, including granite, quartz, marble, and laminate. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional craftsmanship and customer service, beginning with an in-depth consultation to understand our clients' needs and preferences. Each project follows a structured process that involves precise measurements, professional installation by experienced staff, and thorough quality checks to ensure the final product meets our rigorous standards.

To maintain the highest level of excellence and compliance, we conduct formal risk assessments before each project, ensuring all equipment and installation techniques are safe and effective. Additionally, we adhere strictly to local building codes and fire safety regulations, and require all our subcontractors to provide proof of current liability insurance before commencing any work. This commitment to safety and accountability safeguards both our clients and our business, ensuring a smooth installation experience from start to finish.

Our business collaborates with subcontractors for various installation projects; however, we do not require them to provide proof of their liability insurance before starting their work.
